verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one bulk action of its own: acknowledging many simultaneously created incidents (10 or 30) with a single tap, which stops the phone from ringing. Everything else is weaker. The documented API is per-item CRUD on monitors, with list filtering and pagination but no bulk endpoints, and Terraform is mentioned only in passing as an automation integration. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond incident acknowledgement (bulk edit, pause or delete of monitors and other resources), bulk API endpoints, bulk actions exposed through the MCP server or other AI-native surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.
